integrity: The proof is symbolic and self-contained: the upper bound is rank-nullity from im(B) contained in ker(A), and the converse uses an explicit matrix-unit factorization of every rank-r normal form when 2r is at most n. No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The structural theorem is for full matrix algebras over division rings; arbitrary coefficient rings are not covered. The finite-field consequence counts matrices but does not classify similarity orbits. Originality remains subject to the residual possibility of an equivalent older sandwich-factorization statement under unrelated terminology.
title: Zero-insertive matrices are exactly the half-rank locus
